chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Hammad ibn Isa and Fadala from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:
He said to me: 'Recite in the Witr prayer in its three rak'at with

key_terms.سَلِّمْ: Salutation (ending the prayer partially or fully)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method of recitation and salutation for the Witr prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar prescribes reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas in all three rak'at of Witr, a practice emphasized in Shia jurisprudence for its thematic completeness. The instruction to offer a single salutation (salam) in the first two rak'at while remaining in prayer allows the worshipper to stay in a state of readiness, facilitating the transition to Fajr or enabling the Imam to add a concluding rak'at if necessary.
